parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, s.id AS scene_id, s.scene_number, s.title AS scene_title, s.summary, s.characters_present, s.location, s.emotional_tone, s.production_metadata, sh.id AS shot_id, sh.shot_number, sh.shot_type, sh.duration_seconds, sh.description AS shot_description, sh.camera_movement FROM projects p JOIN scenes s ON p.id = s.project_id JOIN shots sh ON s.id = sh.scene_id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state = 'shot_planned' AND s.fight_scene = true ORDER BY s.scene_number, sh.shot_number

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "{{ $env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3' }}",
  "prompt": "You are a fight choreography director. Break down each fight scene into cinematic beats mapped to shots.

Project: '{{ $('Execute Logic').item.json.title }}'

Fight scenes: {{ JSON.stringify($('Execute Logic').item.json.fight_scenes) }}

For each fight scene, generate:
1. fight_type: {sword, hand-to-hand, gun, mixed, magical, chase}
2. intensity: 1-10 scale
3. beats: array of {
     beat_number: int,
     shot_id: which shot it maps to,
     action: description of the combat beat,
     technique: specific combat technique used,
     characters_involved: array,
     impact_level: 1-10,
     camera_angle: {low, high, eye-level, dutch, birdseye},
     speed_ramp: {none, slow-mo, speed-up},
     sound_design: specific sound notes,
     duration_seconds: estimated time
   }
4. key_moments: array of highlight moments
5. safety_notes: choreography safety considerations

Return as JSON array with scene_id as key.",
  "stream": false,
  "format": "json"
}

parameters.query: UPDATE shots SET fight_type = $2, fight_intensity = $3, beat_number = $4, action_description = $5, combat_technique = $6, characters_in_fight = $7::jsonb, impact_level = $8, camera_angle_override = $9, speed_ramp = $10, sound_design_notes = $11, fight_metadata = $12::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
UPDATE projects SET fight_choreography_done = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'fight_choreography_complete', $2::jsonb, NOW())

values.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ state: 'fight_choreographed', total_beats: $('Execute Logic (Fights)').item.json.total_beats, total_fight_scenes: $('Execute Logic (Fights)').item.json.total_fight_scenes }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'fight_choreographed', project_id: $('Execute Logic (Fights)').item.json.project_id, total_beats: $('Execute Logic (Fights)').item.json.total_beats, total_fight_scenes: $('Execute Logic (Fights)').item.json.total_fight_scenes }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'error', message: 'No fight scenes found for project' }) }}
